title: ze_minecraft_adventure
description:
This is a port of a map from CS:GO.

Map made by Cuniczek
Ported by Puklica (to report a bug, contact me)

Map Features:

4 different levels - Overworld, The Nether, Jungle, The End
2 bossfights - Ghast, Ender dragon
special items - Sword, Bow, Flint and steel, Block builder, Cake (Heal), Torches

The map doesn't work properly without the CS2Fixes plugin.
